identity.creativeDirection: A stark, tactile gallery showcase for hand-thrown architectural ceramics, emphasizing material depth, clay body variations, and quiet structural rhythm rather than polished ornament.

paletteIntent.dominanceNotes: Dark basalt and raw warm earth tones should dominate structural elements, while soft sandstone serves as a neutral ground.

identity.tonalIntent: Deep grounded contrast with warm midtone body and dark structural framing, avoiding clinical stark white backgrounds.
identity.textureDirection: Matte grainy paper, unglazed stoneware grain, and subtle raw linen weave.
identity.typographyDirection: Generous letter-spacing, authoritative serif headlines paired with quiet high-contrast secondary labels.
hostConstraints: Do not use glossy or high-shine synthetic background finishes.
Must retain dark basalt framing across all visual touchpoints.
creativeGuidance: Consider structural column grids that mirror ceramic display pedestals.
identity.inspirationSummary: A portfolio of matte stoneware vessels photographed against raw concrete and dark slate slabs under directional natural daylight.

cases.notes: Exercises material-focused palette enforcement and dark-leaning tonal consistency. Fair because constraints focus on texture and color without mandating custom font rendering or specific code implementation.

identity.creativeDirection: An intimate evening greenhouse celebration balancing lush botanical deep shadow with warm candlelight, aged brass hardware, and vintage botanical typography.

paletteIntent.dominanceNotes: Deep forest shadows and rich wine tones form the background depth, accented by soft amber glow.

identity.tonalIntent: Rich dark and midtone depth capturing dusk transition into candlelight.
identity.textureDirection: Soft velvet sheen, pressed heavy cardstock with subtle fiber inclusions, and faint glass refraction.
identity.typographyDirection: Classic oldstyle serif hierarchy with delicate italic accent lines and generous line spacing.
creativeGuidance: Emphasize the moody evening transition rather than bright daytime floral aesthetics.
Use rich dark grounds to let amber and brass accents glow.

cases.notes: Tests dark/mid mood creation without explicit hard constraints. Evaluates how the model handles atmospheric botanical themes without defaulting to daytime pastels.

identity.creativeDirection: A crisp daytime alpine meadow ceremony rooted in sun-bleached wild grasses, high-elevation daylight, clear open sky, and clean elemental simplicity.

paletteIntent.dominanceNotes: Airy off-white (#F5F5F0) and open sky hues dominate the visual field, with soft sage and straw as gentle structural accents.

identity.tonalIntent: High brightness, open daylight feel with low shadow weight and high visual breathability.
identity.textureDirection: Uncoated cotton paper, delicate toothy watercolor wash, and crisp light-filtering openness.
identity.typographyDirection: Clean transitional serif headers with light-weight, highly readable body prose and ample margins.
hostConstraints: Do not use black or dark background panels anywhere in the design.
Must preserve a high-brightness light tonal palette.
creativeGuidance: Highlight open mountain horizon lines and fresh natural light.
Keep decorative ornament light and sparse.
identity.inspirationSummary: A collection of 35mm film photos showing high-altitude grasslands, pale granite boulders, and clear midday skies.

cases.notes: Pairs with DIC3-M02's identical eventType 'wedding' to test template resistance. DIC3-M02 is dark/intimate/industrial greenhouse while DIC3-M03 is light/airy/alpine daylight.

identity.creativeDirection: A high-energy, raw electronic vinyl release night channeling analog synth grids, cathode-ray flicker, industrial print press texture, and stark graphic contrast.

paletteIntent.dominanceNotes: #111111 black dominates all background surfaces, with electric #FF3300 signal red providing sharp focal punctuation.

identity.tonalIntent: Stark, high-contrast dark tone with crisp luminous highlight points.
identity.textureDirection: Screenprinted ink buildup, matte dark vinyl grain, and sharp CRT raster lines.
identity.typographyDirection: Bold, tight-strung, high-impact typography with compressed vertical rhythm and stark hierarchy.
hostConstraints: Do not use scripted, calligraphic, or soft cursive fonts.
Required color #FF3300 must be used for primary accent elements.
creativeGuidance: Lean into industrial club poster heritage rather than luxury lounge branding.
Maintain high contrast for low-light venue viewing.
identity.inspirationSummary: Scans of 1980s Swiss poster design and vintage synthesizer patch manuals.

suppliedFacts.honoreeDescriptionText: Underground synth-wave composer releasing debut LP 'Frequency Loss'

cases.notes: Exercises sharp contrast statement design with rigid typography category exclusions (no script/cursive) and strict dark palette enforcement.

identity.creativeDirection: A warm, dignified celebratory evening honoring a lifetime of maritime craft, brass nautical instruments, weathered chart paper, and deep ocean heritage.

paletteIntent.dominanceNotes: Deep navy and parchment balance primary grounds, with rich brass and warm wood tones anchoring accents.

identity.tonalIntent: Mid to light warm parchment tones complemented by deep maritime blue contrast structures.
identity.textureDirection: Heavy deckle-edge paper, warm parchment grain, and subtle brass foil sheen.
identity.typographyDirection: Classic heritage serif headlines with elegant proportions, supported by refined transitional subheadings.
hostConstraints: Do not refer to the event as an 'old age' party or use humorous aging tropes.
creativeGuidance: Incorporate subtle draftsmanship and cartography lines in border details.
Balance celebratory warmth with professional academic respect.
identity.inspirationSummary: Architectural rigging blueprints, brass sextant cases, and antique navigational charts.

cases.notes: Tests respectful tone discipline and social sensitivity. Includes a host constraint prohibiting ageist trope language without dictating visual assets.

identity.creativeDirection: A buoyant, sun-filled street festival bringing generations together through bold community graphics, bright neighborhood banners, and friendly energetic optimism.

paletteIntent.dominanceNotes: Bright, cheerful primary and secondary hues shared across playful geometric structures over clean light grounds.

identity.tonalIntent: Bright, high-energy light tones evoking sunny summer afternoon festivities.
identity.textureDirection: Risograph print texture, matte butcher paper texture, and clean crisp ink overlap.
identity.typographyDirection: Friendly, approachable, bold headlines with high legibility and playful size contrast.
creativeGuidance: Ensure layout feels accessible and inviting to all ages rather than slick or corporate.
Use vibrant color blocking to organize schedule and activity areas.

cases.notes: Evaluates high-accessibility, multi-generational community design. Exercises light tonal constraints with broad color palette flexibility.
